also_written: possibly the 'Mau-nun-gai' (OCR 'Mau-mm-gai') named second chief of the Little Calumet village in May 1812 (Andreas p. 79) - identity NOT asserted
persons.note: One of the chiefs of the Calumet village. Potawatomi, Calumet village. 15 and 16 August: Killed Sgt Hays and was mortally wounded by Hays's bayonet; died days later at the Calumet village (Wau-Bun). Schoolcraft 1820 (via Quaife) tells the same duel with the Indian unnamed. Afterwards: Died of the wound some days after 15 Aug.
